tours.name: Export Employees to a File
tours.description: Learn how to open the export window for selected employees and choose the fields to include, so the list can be opened in a spreadsheet.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to open the export window for selected employees and choose the fields to include, so the list can be opened in a spreadsheet.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: The employee list is the main place to filter, group and export people.

description_i18n.en_US: The employee list is the main place to filter, group and export people.

steps.title: Switch to List
steps.content: Click List to see the employees as a table.

content_i18n.en_US: Click List to see the employees as a table.

steps.description: The list shows one line per employee with the columns you can filter, group and export.

description_i18n.en_US: The list shows one line per employee with the columns you can filter, group and export.

steps.title: Select employees
steps.content: Tick the box in front of an employee.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the box in front of an employee.

steps.description: Only ticked employees are exported. Tick the box in the heading to select every employee of the list.

description_i18n.en_US: Only ticked employees are exported. Tick the box in the heading to select every employee of the list.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to the ticked employees is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to the ticked employees is in this menu.

steps.title: Export
steps.description: The export window lets you choose which fields become columns of the file.

description_i18n.en_US: The export window lets you choose which fields become columns of the file.

steps.title: Choose a field
steps.content: Click a field on the left to add it to the file.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a field on the left to add it to the file.

steps.description: The list on the left holds every field of the employee. The fields on the right become the columns. Use the search box to find a field quickly.

description_i18n.en_US: The list on the left holds every field of the employee. The fields on the right become the columns. Use the search box to find a field quickly.

steps.title: Close
steps.content: Click Close to leave without exporting.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Close to leave without exporting.

steps.description: The Export button would download the file as Excel or CSV. The Close button leaves the window without downloading anything.

description_i18n.en_US: The Export button would download the file as Excel or CSV. The Close button leaves the window without downloading anything.
